page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. Powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 104 virtual CPUs alongside 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of system memory per vCPU core.

The instance configuration includes a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation. It does not provide attached local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators, requiring network-attached block storage options for persistent disk volumes. The high ratio of dedicated vCPUs relative to memory makes this instance cost-effective for compute-dense operations that require parallel processing power without demanding large memory footprints per core.

Given its compute-heavy allocation profile and high network bandwidth, the ecs.c6.26xlarge instance is suited for batch processing, high-performance computing modeling, web server clusters, media encoding, and distributed compute workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, it offers 104 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of memory, providing roughly 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is designed for compute-heavy applications that do not require massive per-core memory capacities. It features a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system contains no local ephemeral storage, requiring remote block storage, and does not include hardware GPU acceleration. This hardware allocation profile offers qualitative efficiency for high-concurrency CPU workloads where processing throughput is prioritized over local storage velocity or high RAM-to-CPU ratios. The ecs.c6.26xlarge instance is intended for high-performance computing, video processing, large-scale web serving, and parallel batch processing tasks.
